description: Defines the class Image_Canvas_WithMap, which extends Image_Canvas to add support for image maps and various drawing methods such as lines, polygons, rectangles, ellipses, pieslices, text, and overlay images.

classes.name: Image_Canvas_WithMap
classes.description: A class extending Image_Canvas to include image map functionality and drawing methods with support for image maps.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the canvas and optionally creates an image map if 'usemap' parameter is true.

methods.name: line
methods.description: Draws a line and adds it to the image map if available.

methods.name: addVertex
methods.description: Adds a vertex to a polygon and to the image map if available.

methods.name: addSpline
methods.description: Adds a splined vertex to a polygon and to the image map if available.

methods.name: polygon
methods.description: Draws a polygon and adds it to the image map if available.

methods.name: rectangle
methods.description: Draws a rectangle and adds it to the image map if available.

methods.name: ellipse
methods.description: Draws an ellipse and adds it to the image map if available.

methods.name: pieslice
methods.description: Draws a pie slice and adds it to the image map if available.

methods.name: addText
methods.description: Adds text to the image and to the image map if available.

methods.name: image
methods.description: Overlays an image and adds it to the image map if available.

methods.name: getImageMap
methods.description: Returns the image map object if available.
